performance.verdict: Lead surge is real but pipeline is hollow — fix intake before scaling.

findings.text: GHL shows only 59 contacts against 70 Meta leads (28d), with 0 opportunities created — 11+ leads unaccounted for and none progressing to pipeline.
⛔ Extension with Marwan overdue since 2026-08-31 — engagement is month-to-month lapsed; next 3 months ungated.
⛔ SMS automation and Zoho Voice access both overdue since 2026-08-31 — contact rate was already the bottleneck; these blockers worsen it.
3-day lead signal (Sep 18–20: 8, 6, 10 leads/day) vs prior 3 days (Sep 15–17: 7, 5, 5) is accelerating; CPL dropped ~46% 7d vs prior 7d to ~$25.80 — efficiency confirmed improving.
GBP actions collapsed -88% (7d vs prior 7d) — 0 actions on Sep 16–20 after averaging 8–13/day in prior weeks; organic call channel effectively dark.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake flow: reconcile 11 missing leads and diagnose why 0 of 59 contacts converted to opportunities.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 59 contacts against 70 Meta leads (28d) with 0 opportunities created — at least 11 leads are unaccounted for and none are progressing. Audit the GHL form-to-contact sync, check for failed webhook triggers, and trace why no contacts are being moved to the opportunity stage. Success is: contact count matches Meta lead count within ±5%, and at least new incoming leads are creating opportunities. Resolve by 2026-09-24.

suggestions.text: Hold Meta budget at $90/day; re-check 3-day lead rate on Sep 24 before any scale move.
suggestions.monday_update: The 3-day lead signal is strong (8, 6, 10 leads/day Sep 18–20) and CPL is at $25.80, but 0 pipeline opportunities means we cannot confirm lead quality. Hold spend at the current ~$90/day and do not scale until the GHL intake fix (S1) confirms leads are reaching the pipeline. Re-check on 2026-09-24: if opportunities > 0 and CPL holds below $30, a +20% budget increase is defensible.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP: 0 actions for 5 consecutive days — investigate profile status by Sep 24.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped -88% week-over-week and have been zero for the last 5 recorded days (Sep 16–20), after averaging 8–13 actions/day previously. Check that the Justice Consumer Law GBP profile is still verified, published, and not flagged. This is the organic call channel — 57 calls came through it in the 28-day window. Confirm profile status by 2026-09-24; if still dark, escalate to a manual GBP audit.
